description:
Search the Fortitude21 catalogue of liquid containment: jerry cans, pails, tins, drums, spill pallets, closures and handling equipment in steel, stainless, aluminium, tinplate and UN-rated HDPE.
Use when: finding products that fit a need. Then: get_product_details for one record, compare_products for two to six, get_product_pricing for terms, create_quote_request to ask for a price.
Inputs: q and every filter combine with AND, so each one narrows the result. q expands synonyms, such as bund for spill pallet. A product with no recorded value for a filtered attribute is left out rather than assumed to match, so an empty result means nothing meets every condition: drop a filter and search again.
Returns: total, pages and per product sku, name, url, category, capacity_l, material, un_status, pricing_type and moq.
Behaviour: read-only; the same query gives the same result for one catalogue version.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

category.description: Category slug from get_product_categories, e.g. spill-containment

certification.description: UN for any UN-rated design, or a design code such as 3H1 or 3A1

material.description: hdpe, polypropylene, polyethylene, stainless, steel, galvanised, aluminium, tinplate, plastic or metal. Resolved to the material family, so hdpe does not return polypropylene

pricing_type.description: Filter by pricing model. Most products are PRICE_ON_REQUEST

q.description: Free text, e.g. "20 litre steel fuel can" or "spill pallet for 4 drums". Leave out to list by filters alone

sort.description: Order of results. relevance (default) needs q

name: search_products

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

query.description: The search as read: terms, synonyms used and filters

results.description: One summary per product: id, sku, name, url, category, capacity_l, material, material_family, un_status, pricing_type, starting_from, currency, moq, orderable_units, image, updated_at, matched_on

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: Search Fortitude21 products
